canada.title: Regina property tax set for 5.81% hike in proposed 2027 budget
canada.summary: Next year's budget was prepared by city staff and released Thursday ahead of Regina city council's deliberations on Dec. 7 and 11.

canada.title: Manitoba shuts down trucking company linked to fatal Brandon crash
canada.summary: A Winnipeg-based trucking company has been shut down by the province after investigators concluded it was connected to a firm that was banned and later linked to a fatal crash in Brandon.

canada.title: House fire and explosion rocks community southeast of Calgary
canada.summary: Fire crew are on scene responding to an explosion and fire in a community southeast of Calgary Thursday morning.

canada.title: Mother of teen slain in Carman mass killing ends lawsuit against child welfare agency
canada.summary: The mother of a 17-year-old victim in a mass slaying in Manitoba has discontinued her lawsuit against a child welfare agency that she claimed failed to protect her daughter.

canada.title: Man convicted of 2nd-degree murder in Halifax gas station stabbing
canada.summary: One of three men charged with murder in the stabbing death of Terrance Dixon was found guilty this week of second-degree murder. This was the second jury trial for James Arthur Williams. The first trial ended when he changed his plea to guilty, but he later withdrew that plea.

canada.title: Isle-aux-Coudres residents stranded again after 2nd ferry breaks down in less than a week
canada.summary: Isle-aux-Coudres residents are cut off from the mainland for the second time in less than a week after the ferry sent to replace the island's broken one also broke down.

canada.title: Woman killed in ATV crash on Grand Manan
canada.summary: New Brunswick RCMP say a 63-year-old woman from Grand Manan is dead following an ATV crash on the island.

canada.title: 'Power in this movement': Yukon NDP tables 100s of letters against Tenancies Act changes
canada.summary: The Official Opposition MLA behind a motion asking the Yukon legislature to reconsider changes to the Residential Tenancies Act says there’s a movement of people standing up to the amendments passed last week.

canada.title: 2 arrested, police searching for suspect after Mississauga apartment building allegedly set on fire twice
canada.summary: Police say they have arrested two people and are searching for a third in connection with two fires at a Mississauga apartment building that they allege were deliberately set.

canada.title: ‘Where’s the door?’: Accessibility advocate says Saskatoon BRT stations need more work
canada.summary: As Saskatoon moves forward with building out its bus rapid transit system, an accessibility advocate and bus rider is raising concerns about some of the new platforms.

canada.title: N.W.T. MLA wants to ease process of bringing home children who died at residential school
canada.summary: Tu Nedhé-Wiilideh MLA Richard Edjericon tabled Bill 62, the Residential School Remains Identification and Repatriation Act, in the Legislative Assembly on Wednesday. He said it sets out a legal framework for identifying and repatriating the remains of children from residential school sites.

canada.title: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2M bribe to release Ryan Wedding's second-in-command
canada.summary: A Mexican judge has been arrested on allegations that he accepted a $2-million US bribe in exchange for granting bail to a man accused of acting as second-in-command to Ryan Wedding, the former Canadian Olympic snowboarder turned alleged drug kingpin, American officials said on Thursday.

canada.title: Man awaiting trial in killing of Montreal woman dies, coroner investigating
canada.summary: Youcef Moussaoui, 33, had been awaiting trial on charges of first-degree murder for the death of 45-year-old Leila Ben Salem.

canada.title: Kelowna hair salon closing after years of crime and social disorder
canada.summary: For nearly five decades, Pat Cudmore has made a career out of helping people feel good when they leave her chair. Now, the Kelowna hairstylist is facing an uncertain future

canada.title: Shell drives spike in oil exploration bids off the coast of Newfoundland
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador's offshore energy regulator says Shell, the London-headquartered company, successfully bid on six exploration licenses off the province's east and southeast coast.

canada.title: 'Delivered the baby myself': B.C. mom has daughter on side of highway
canada.summary: Marissa Ross was driving from Bridge Lake to Royal Inland Hospital in Kamloops to give birth to her fourth baby. But she didn't manage to make it to the hospital before her daughter made an appearance.
